loudnorm.method: ffmpeg loudnorm, same method as wired-100-20261031 (dynamic; wired file itself measured output -24.01, so dynamic loudnorm on sparse demo material does not by itself hit -14)
loudnorm.honest_statement: Final demo measures -16.27 LUFS, NOT -14. A straight +2.27 dB gain would push true peak above 0 (TP already -1.39) and clip. The -14 LUFS target stands for final delivery with real, denser audio; this sparse tone demo cannot honestly claim it. File is therefore named 'measured', not 'minus14lufs'.
